name: Hawkpair Palm
description: Strike with one palm and follow at once with the other so two blows land as a pair.

name: Hawkpair Cover
description: Spread both arms like a pair of wings with qi along them to cover the chest.

name: Hawkpair Dash
description: Dash forward on both legs together with qi in each as one quick plunge.

name: Hawkpair Lash
description: Throw a lash of qi from each hand so two strands cross on the target.

name: Hawkpair Pin
description: Pin a foe's two arms at once with two clamps of qi that close like talons.

name: Hawkpair Salve
description: Lay both palms over a hurt ally or yourself and pour twinned mending qi into the wound.

name: Hawkpair Plunge
description: Plunge on the foe with both hands leading so the dive and the double blow arrive together.

name: Hawkpair Wings
description: Fold two great wings of qi round a wounded ally and keep them there while their wounds close.

name: Hawkpair Rending
description: Tear both wings of qi open at once and rend everything in the ring ahead.

name: Twin Hawk Fall
description: The school's closing stroke: two hawks of qi stoop together and land as one blow that breaks the ground.

name: Edict Palm
description: Strike with a firm palm that gives the foe no room to argue the blow.

name: Edict Veil
description: Draw a stern veil of qi over the body that holds against the first blow.

name: Edict Step
description: Step in one measured pace and plant the foot to command the space.

name: Edict Lash
description: Crack a lash of qi across a foe's face to rebuke a reckless advance.

name: Edict Seal
description: Press a stern seal of qi onto a foe's chest and still their techniques for a time.

name: Edict Remedy
description: Pass a judge's calm qi into a hurt ally and set their injury to rights.

name: Edict Reading
description: Read the weight of a foe's qi and strength as a judge reads a case.

name: Edict Crush
description: Pass sentence with a crushing blow that flattens the foe's stance and pins them down.

name: Edict Mantle
description: Wrap an ally in a heavy mantle of qi that turns blows and gradually closes their wounds.

name: Final Edict
description: Deliver the last word as a blow that strikes the foe and seals their qi behind it.

name: Supreme Edict
description: The school's closing stroke: a sentence of qi pronounced over the whole field that bears down on every foe in it.

name: Braid Palm
description: Twist two strands of qi together down the arm and strike with the braid.

name: Braid Cover
description: Weave a close braid of qi over the forearms to take a blow without splitting.

name: Braid Tread
description: Cross the feet along a braided path of qi and come out facing the foe's flank.

name: Braid Lash
description: Throw the braid as a heavy rope of qi that hits harder than a single strand.

name: Braid Net
description: Spread the braid into a net and tighten it round a foe's torso and arms.

name: Braid Soothe
description: Braid warm qi through the hurt of an ally or yourself to calm and mend it.

name: Braid Surge
description: Unwind the braid all at once into a broad surge that scatters those ahead.

name: Braid Renewal
description: Braid fresh qi into an ally so wounds close and spent reserves are made good together.

name: Fourfold Braid
description: Wind four strands round arms and trunk so each blow strikes hard and holds the guard.

name: Crowned Braid
description: The school's closing stroke: all strands are crowned into one great braid that strikes and guards as one.

name: Duet Pulse
description: Strike on two linked beats from two tracks so the blow lands as a chord.

name: Duet Veil
description: Hold a veil on each track so a blow must pass both to reach the body.

name: Duet Glide
description: Glide along both tracks at once for a smooth fast move in either direction.

name: Duet Thread
description: Cast one thread down each track and cross them round a foe's limbs.

name: Duet Spear
description: Drive a lance of qi down two tracks as one stabbing line through a guard.

name: Duet Remedy
description: Send mending qi down two tracks into a wounded ally so both sides of the hurt close together.

name: Duet Reading
description: Read a foe through both tracks and compare the readings to find where they falter.

name: Duet Tide
description: Send two tides from two tracks that meet ahead and break over a wide space.

name: Duet Purge
description: Wash an ally's channels from both tracks and carry out poison taint and sour backlash.

name: Duet Apex
description: Bring both tracks to their peak together and loose a blow that rings across the field.

name: Tracks Unified
description: The school's closing stroke: both tracks are made one in a single surge that crushes foes and fills allies with power.

name: Pinnacle Palm
description: Strike downward from the top of a breath with the Core's qi behind the palm.

name: Pinnacle Cover
description: Hold a high clear veil of qi over the whole body at the peak of the breath.

name: Pinnacle Pace
description: Rise on one pace of qi and land lightly many strides ahead.

name: Pinnacle Lance
description: Cast a high bright lance of qi from the peak of the breath through a guard.

name: Pinnacle Thread
description: Send a high thread out from the peak of the breath and read what it touches.

name: Pinnacle Balm
description: Pour clear balm from the peak of the breath over an ally or yourself to close hurts.

name: Pinnacle Rend
description: Bring the whole weight of the peak down in one blow that rends the guard.

name: Pinnacle Mantle
description: Wrap allies in a mantle from the peak that turns blows and lifts each one's strength.

name: Pinnacle Stoop
description: Flash from the peak of the breath to the foe's side and strike in the same instant.

name: Pinnacle Descent
description: The school's closing stroke: the whole breath is held to its peak and let fall as one blow upon the field.

name: Pledge Pulse
description: Pledge the strike on the breath and drive the palm in when the pledge is made.

name: Pledge Cover
description: Pledge the guard and hold a close layer of qi over the body until the pledge ends.

name: Pledge Glide
description: Pledge a single long stride and take it without wavering from the line.

name: Pledge Snap
description: Send a pledged lash of qi at a foe and recall it to the hand.

name: Pledge Weighing
description: Hold a foe under a pledged weight of qi that grows heavier each breath.

name: Pledge Balm
description: Pledge to an injured ally that they will mend and lead the promised qi into them.

name: Pledge Swell
description: Let the pledged breath out as a surge that bears down on all within reach.

name: Pledge Aegis
description: Cover allies with a pledged guard that grows stronger as long as they stand.

name: Pledge Kept
description: Hold the pledge through the whole fight so the guard stands and wounds close beneath it.

name: Pledge Fulfilled
description: The school's closing stroke: every pledged breath is spent at once in one blow that breaks all in its way.

name: Resolute Pulse
description: Strike with a pulse of qi that does not waver under the foe's counter.

name: Resolute Veil
description: Hold a firm veil of qi that stays whole while the foe pounds on it.

name: Resolute Step
description: Press forward one step into a blow and keep the line without giving ground.

name: Resolute Lance
description: Drive a lance of qi straight through the foe's counter and into the body.

name: Resolute Bind
description: Lock a foe in a bind of qi that holds however hard they pull.

name: Resolute Remedy
description: Give a hurt ally a steady unfaltering flow of qi that mends and does not stop.

name: Resolute Reading
description: Read how firmly a foe holds their stance and where their resolve gives.

name: Resolute Crush
description: Bring the full weight of an unbending will down in a blow that pins the foe.

name: Resolute Mantle
description: Wrap an ally in a steadfast mantle of qi that turns blows and closes their wounds.

name: Resolute Breaker
description: Break the foe's guard and their rhythm with one unyielding blow of qi.

name: Resolute Sundering
description: The school's closing stroke: a single sundering blow of sworn qi that splits the foe's guard and pins them.

name: Steadfast Hand
description: Strike along a held line and keep the palm there until the qi has gone in.

name: Steadfast Veil
description: Hold the veil on the bearing and let blows slide off it without turning it.

name: Steadfast Pacing
description: Stride along the bearing in even paces and arrive without losing the line.

name: Steadfast Thread
description: Draw a steady thread round a foe's wrist and hold it to the bearing.

name: Steadfast Knock
description: Knock the foe's guard off its line with one precise beat of qi.

name: Steadfast Salve
description: Lay salve of steady qi over an ally's hurt and keep it there until it knits.

name: Steadfast Surge
description: Surge outward along the bearing and push back every foe near the line.

name: Steadfast Mantle
description: Hold a guard on the bearing for allies and feed each one a calm even strength.

name: Steadfast Reckoning
description: Count the foe's faults along the bearing and strike once where all of them meet.

name: Steady Heading Kept
description: The school's closing stroke: a blow held true to the bearing that no feint or turn can deflect.

name: Taut Pulse
description: Draw the pulse taut like a bowstring and release it into the strike.

name: Taut Veil
description: Pull the veil tight over the body so blows ring off it.

name: Taut Glide
description: Release the drawn qi from the legs and glide forward in one smooth line.

name: Taut Lash
description: Snap a taut line of qi out at a target and recall it before the foe can grab it.

name: Taut Seal
description: Draw a tight seal of qi over a foe's centre and stop their techniques for a time.

name: Taut Remedy
description: Pass a taut thread of mending qi into an ally and draw their wound shut.

name: Taut Divining
description: Pluck the taut field like a string and read from its trembling who moves within.

name: Taut Release
description: Release the fully drawn field at once as a violent ring of force.

name: Taut Cleansing
description: Draw the taut field over an ally and strip out taint and backlash like dirt from a rope.

name: Fullest Draw
description: Draw the field to its fullest and loose a lance of qi that pierces and then bursts.

name: Hundredfold Release
description: The school's closing stroke: a hundred threads of the drawn field are loosed together over the whole front.

name: Unyielding Palm
description: Strike without pause and keep the palm in contact until the Core's qi has gone through.

name: Unyielding Veil
description: Hold a veil that bends but does not break under any blow.

name: Unyielding Step
description: Take a step into the foe's blow and let the Core's qi hold the stance.

name: Unyielding Lance
description: Push a lance of the Core's qi through a guard that bends but does not break.

name: Unyielding Hold
description: Hold a foe down under a weight that does not tire.

name: Unyielding Balm
description: Give an ally steady balm from the Core's reserves that keeps mending as long as it is given.

name: Unyielding Tide
description: Sweep a tide from the Core's qi across the ground that does not slacken at its edge.

name: Unyielding Cloak
description: Cloak an ally in an unbroken mantle that turns blows and closes wounds beneath it.

name: Unyielding Resolve
description: Harden the Core's qi into a resolve that no strain wears down and share it with those near.

name: Unyielding Finale
description: The school's closing stroke: a last blow struck from an unbroken guard that fells the foe and leaves the user whole.
